import re


def toy_model(prompt, text):
    words = set(re.findall(r"[a-z]+", text.lower()))
    best, best_hits = "unknown", 0
    for label, listed in re.findall(r"^- (\w+): (.+)$", prompt, re.M):

    return best

    print(toy_model(PROMPT, text))
